evidence: T-049 (apps/web/e2e/t049-keyboard-critical-path.spec.ts): keyboard only (Tab to reach, Enter/Space/arrows to act): sign-in via the OIDC popup with nothing in local/session storage; register -> incident; status header with state, deadline, owner, next safe action; evidence citation drawer that traps focus and returns it on Escape; compatibility and advisory plan tables; assign to self, accept, handoff with reason and next-action deadline including an error summary that links to the field and a 409 version conflict that is announced assertively, reloads and is retried; pinned SOP (cold-chain revision, original/current deadline, SET history) and a PAUSE deadline event with the original deadline unchanged in API truth; spending-session bounds (incident, merchant, action, amount 185.00, currency USD, purpose, expiry) displayed and announced before the effect-named confirmation; approval recorded with 'Kite session not confirmed'; hold recorded with the request still PENDING in API truth; recovered incident closeout gate matching the API. axe-core WCAG 2.0/2.1/2.2 A/AA: zero violations on every visited view; visible 3 px focus outline checked.

T-050 (t050-responsive.spec.ts): command center, incident overview, recovery plan with approval, spend with an UNKNOWN payment and verification and notifications at 320, 375, 768, 1024, 1440 CSS px, 200% zoom (720 CSS px at 2x) and 400% reflow (320 CSS px at 4x): no page horizontal overflow and no element outside the viewport except inside labelled scroll regions; state, deadline, blocker and next action visible; primary actions visible, in the viewport and >= 44x44 CSS px; disabled retry visible with its reason.

T-051 (t051-honest-states.spec.ts + apps/web/test/t051-axis-honesty.test.ts): seeded through the real packages: freshness FRESH/STALE/OFFLINE/INVALID/NO_SIGNAL with fleet counts matching the API; Kite sessions UNKNOWN (dropped response), FAILED (declined), never requested and CONFIRMED with separate local-authority, transport and capability badges; a post-egress UNKNOWN payment whose capability became UNSUPPORTED stays UNKNOWN (not Failed) with retry disabled and manual review shown; declined payment FAILED; distinct service-job vs purchase-order cards and axes; CONFIRMED payment labelled as not proving recovery; recovery gate RECOVERED only for the closed incident (VERIFYING/OBSERVING and reopened read Not recovered). Every badge has text, an icon shape and an sr-only description and is never green (rgb(34,197,94)) unless FRESH/CONFIRMED/PASSED/RECOVERED. Notifications: approver receives APPROVAL_REQUIRED, CRITICAL_INCIDENT, SPEND_EXCEPTION, PROVIDER_CHANGE, RECOVERY, INCIDENT_REOPENED, EVIDENCE_GAP; two approval-required notifications collapse into one item ('2 updates') with an allowlisted deep link and recovery path; spend unknown is never phrased as success; delivery UNKNOWN shown as such; the viewer receives none.

T-052 (t052-chart-fallback.spec.ts): chart accessible name with threshold and anomaly count, current-value text (value, UTC time, LIVE, quality, freshness, SIMULATED_INPUT), data table with Time/Value/Unit/Ingestion/Quality/Origin/Anomaly columns reachable by keyboard, anomaly markers with a distinct triangle shape plus 'Above threshold' text, one threshold line, pause (aria-pressed) that makes zero telemetry requests for 7 s and resumes from the server, transitions present by default and none under prefers-reduced-motion, no infinitely pulsing alerts.

API security (apps/kite-broker/test/m12-api-security.int.test.ts, apps/api/test): uniform 401 for missing/malformed/HS256-forged/wrong-audience/wrong-issuer/expired/unknown-subject tokens on every /v1 route; 429 + Retry-After after repeated failures from one source (other sources unaffected); strict body/query parsing; Idempotency-Key and If-Match required; 409 VERSION_CONFLICT with currentVersion and idempotent replay of the winner; fulfillment webhook HMAC over raw bytes (bad signature, tampered body, missing header and unknown binding all the same 401; replay DUPLICATE; stale timestamp 401; 70 KiB 413); issuance 202 with sessionConfirmed false; CSP/nosniff/no-referrer/no-store/no CORS on every response; opaque errors.

schemaOrApiChanges: @uptimebuyer/contracts/api: request/response schemas and header contracts (new subpath export).

Additive package functions: data getSessionProfile, listAssignableMembers, listAssetDevices; incidents getIncidentPins; evidence getCurrentIncidentEvidenceRevision; planning listPlanApprovalRequests; commerce listIncidentCommerce, recordApprovalHold (approval.hold.v1 MATERIAL_INPUT ledger entry). M04's stale-version error now carries currentVersion.
migrationOrRollback: No migration. Rollback = revert the M12 commits; the additive package functions have no other callers and the M04 conflict detail is additive. Hold ledger entries are append-only evidence and stay.
specAmbiguitiesResolved: UI-SPEC §15 names Next.js App Router; M12 uses a React + Vite SPA served same-origin by apps/api (ADR 0007): all views are authenticated per-principal reads, so server rendering adds a second server and CSP surface without benefit.
No module owned the HTTP API; M12 built apps/api per REPOSITORY-PLAN as thin routes over the existing package functions.
Approve/hold: 'hold' has no lifecycle in STATE-MACHINES, so it is an approver's attested ledger decision that leaves the request PENDING and the plan APPROVABLE.

API paths follow API-EVENT-SPEC where it names them; reads it does not name (fleet, telemetry, timeline, members, evidence, compatibility, plans, incident authorities/orders, recovery, ledger, notifications) use resource-style paths; custom verbs use {id}:{verb}. Authority status changes use :change-status (SUSPENDED/ACTIVE/REVOKED) because M09 exposes one command for all three.
Sign-in: authorization code + PKCE in a popup so no verifier or token touches browser storage; a reload requires sign-in again.
Zoom levels are emulated as CSS-pixel viewports with device scale factors (200% of 1440 = 720 CSS px; 400% of 1280 = 320 CSS px), which is how WCAG 1.4.10 reflow is defined.
Order creation/dispatch, reconciliation and recovery engine steps remain worker/broker operations; the console shows their results and offers only human commands.
securityReview: Authn bypass: every /v1 route except public-config and the webhook is authenticated in an onRequest hook, and every protected handler additionally requires the context (ctxOf) so a routing quirk cannot reach a handler unauthenticated; HS256-forged, wrong audience/issuer, expired and unknown-subject tokens are refused uniformly (tested).

IDOR: no route reads a tenant/site/actor from the request; package functions authorize against the resource's own site; cross-tenant equals nonexistent and cross-site is 403 per resource family (tested); approve/hold refuse a request named under another plan before recording anything.
CSRF: bearer tokens only, credentials omitted, no cookies, no CORS headers.
XSS: no raw-HTML sinks (source guard test), document/provider/model text rendered as text, strict CSP without unsafe-inline/eval, frame-ancestors none.

Open redirects: notification deep links accepted only as allowlisted same-origin application paths (unit-tested); the popup callback posts only to an exact same-origin target and the opener checks source and state; the API has no redirect endpoints; the test IdP enforces an exact redirect URI.

Secret leakage: built-bundle scan and source guards; no source maps or env in the bundle; token in memory only (T-049 asserts empty storage); API logger off and errors opaque; config errors name keys only.
Rate limits: per-source auth-failure and webhook-rejection buckets, per-principal bucket on approve/hold/issue/change-status/publish (tested for auth).
S1 (fixed red-first, 6d93a4f -> b64a48a): identity-provider endpoints over plain http on a network host were accepted; now https is required except on loopback.

Also fixed during implementation before commit: policy publication validated the draft before authorization (non-admins got 400 with validation details) — now authorized first and audited; SPA fallback served the shell for any extensionless path — now only console routes.
unresolvedRisks: No step-up authentication or dual approval for spending approval, authority issuance/revocation and high-risk policy publication (UI-SPEC §8.5, §10): needs IdP support (acr/auth_time) — deferred to M13/M14.
Rate-limit buckets are per process; behind a proxy UB_TRUST_PROXY must be set or all clients share one source (and one auth-failure budget).
Fleet health is an N+1 composition and the ledger export is unpaginated; bounded by tenant size, inputs for T-054.

Hold has no idempotency key (a retried hold appends another attested ledger entry); hold requires evidence.submit, so a pure maintenance approver without the operator role is refused by the server while the UI offers the button.
Access tokens are held in memory for up to their lifetime (capped at 1 h); an XSS would expose them, mitigated by the strict CSP.
The e2e harness waits ~125 s for a STALE device because bindings cannot be backdated; the suite adds about 3 minutes to verify.
Assignable members are visible (display names) to anyone with incident.read at the site, including viewers.

truthStatement: M12 completed and locally verified the operator HTTP API, typed client and accessible web console against a throwaway PostgreSQL database seeded through the real module packages with simulated sensors, a recorded-contract broker, a contract-fake CMMS and a loopback test identity provider; no deployment, real identity provider, provider, payment, Kite session, CMMS, physical sensor, physical recovery or real screen-reader user evidence exists, and all of it remains NOT_RUN.
